capabilities: create and edit Go game records with variation trees and markers
import and export SGF game record files
navigate moves and add comments and good/bad move markers
render read-only SGF code blocks embedded in Markdown notes
configure settings globally or per file via frontmatter
extras: English, Korean, and Japanese translations were produced with translation tools, so non-Chinese UI text may contain errors; the author invites corrections.
intentEvidence: This plugin has ported and referenced most functionalities and the UI from Sabaki
motivation: The author built it to help friends learning Go study games and life-and-death problems and manage records like regular notes in Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to store, replay, annotate, or embed Go game records (SGF) alongside regular notes.

relations.evidence: ported and referenced most functionalities and the UI from Sabaki
you can use a plugin like Templater to automatically generate a new file

summary: Go game record manager that plays, edits, and comments SGF boards, and renders read-only SGF code blocks in notes.
